title: metamodel-assetChangeEventCompact.v1
description: Compact metamodel-aligned schema for Asset change events. The global asset identifier is a plain string (AssetInformation.globalAssetId), which is structurally identical to the non-metamodel compact variant. Included for symmetry and documentation purposes.

globalAssetId.description: Global asset identifier (URI). Corresponds to AssetInformation.globalAssetId in the AAS metamodel. Plain string, not a Reference, since globalAssetId is a scalar string in the AAS metamodel.
